sources.entry: Taiga - Agile Project Management Tool based on the Kanban and Scrum methods. (Source Code) MPL-2.0 Docker/Python/Nodejs

summary.name: Taiga
summary.one_liner: Taiga is a free and open-source agile project management tool supporting Kanban and Scrum workflows, available as a hosted service or self-hosted on your own servers.
use_cases: running agile sprints with a Scrum board
tracking work on a Kanban board with WIP limits
managing bugs and issues alongside user stories
self-hosting project management on your own servers
sharing project progress and burndown reports with stakeholders
planning backlog and estimating story points
summary.what_it_does: Taiga provides a Kanban board with epics, sub-tasks, swim lanes, WIP limits and filtering, and can be switched between Kanban and Scrum. It includes backlog and sprint planning with estimations, a sprint task board and burndown charts at project and sprint level. An integrated issue and bug tracker lets issues be customized by type, priority and severity and promoted to user stories. The page also lists a team performance dashboard, a project wiki, personal dashboards and notifications, custom reports via CSV URL, team roles and permissions, and project import/export.
notable: Open source under MPL-2.0 with an on-premise self-hosting option
Switch between Kanban and Scrum workflows within one project
Integrated issue/bug tracker with promotion of issues to user stories
caveats: Hosted-service pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Self-hosting requires running your own servers; the page says the on-premise option suits larger teams or those wanting full data control
